kind: independent source check, not runtime proof
limits: No tests, builds, nodes, or runtime operations ran in this independent review.
Executable verification awaits the normal release build; no executable identity claim is made here.
The inventory is a conservative repository input set. External registry source bytes remain outside this source check.

source_review.author_clock: PASS: checked local timestamp range is reserved on a copied state before stamping; all local items retain one batch counter; final physical high-water covers the final timestamp. Imports stay unchanged. Native publication awaits the single durable barrier before its write gate.
source_review.author_clock_exhaustion: PASS: count/counter/time exhaustion returns before state assignment, clock submission, or data publication. An unaccepted private allocation can be discarded; acknowledged clocks remain protected by durable high-water coverage.
source_review.complete_metadata_rows: PASS: require_end checks the final distinct union after each physical range proves exhaustion. Stable candidate precedence and paged truncation remain unchanged.
source_review.numeric_order: PASS: exact signed/unsigned/finite-float comparisons preserve represented numeric magnitude, signed zero equality, large integer distinctions, and transitivity. NaN API thresholds reject; infinities retain mathematical order.
source_review.preload_failed_references: PASS: private Phase::Failed and CoreKeyPhase::Failed variants and branches are removed. The serialized failed gauge remains zero with an explicit compatibility comment.
source_review.preload_failure: PASS: all worker preload errors retire and detach incomplete keys, clear changes/generation state, retain the diagnostic reason, and select bounded DiskOnly. Required disk reads keep their own error path.
source_review.receipt_revision: PASS: first local mutation again names the common batch counter. Earlier concern about per-item counters is resolved by consecutive author times.
